title: Scout URL Policy Trace v1
description: Request-level URL policy verdicts and whether Scout resolved each paused CDP request. This is page-target Fetch coverage, not browser-wide egress evidence.

url.description: URL with credentials, query, and fragment removed in exported traces.

allowed.description: URL policy verdict, independent of whether CDP resolved the paused request.

resolution.description: Result of Fetch.continueRequest or Fetch.failRequest. Absent in older trace archives.

resolution_error.description: Redacted CDP error text when resolution failed.
